services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Pretend City’s private facility rental package is $2,700 for members and $3,000 for nonmembers. Membership must be active at time of reservation for membership rate. Rental includes two hours private use of the museum after hours. This package includes admission for up to 100 guests (adults and children).. Infants under 12 months are free. Additional guests are $15 per person with maximum limit of 200 guests. Use of facility resources such as community rooms, tables and chairs are available for an additional fee. services.name: Museum Rentals
services.desc: Pretend City is one of Orange County’s premier special event venues, offering a unique, eclectic spin on event hosting. Located in the heart of Orange County, Pretend City is an easily accessible facility designed to ensure a fun experience in an environment created for play and learning. You and your guests will enjoy an imaginative, unforgettable event with our colorful décor and innovative design that provides a unique atmosphere for any event. Allow us to help you create a one-of-a-kind event that your guests are sure to remember! For more information on facility rental rates and availability please email events@pretendcity.org Our venue is the perfect place for your Holiday

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Pretend City offers a variety of field trip options for your school. All field trips are fun, educational, and hands-on play for preschool through second graders! Our field trips are aligned with Common Core standards and Preschool Learning Foundations. Designed for grades TK and under. Guide your group through Pretend City at your own pace with our printed Exploration Guide! Learn about our community codes, then dive into hands-on learning activities of your choice.
